name: TCS Digital candidate volunteers pan-India relocation — location_agnostic_signal fires, weak_reverse_questions suppressed

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about your final-year project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I built a fraud-detection pipeline for campus UPI transactions — XGBoost on a class-imbalanced dataset, SMOTE plus focal loss. Got recall to 0.84 at precision 0.71. Python, FastAPI, Postgres. Repo on github.com/aarav/fraud-detect. CGPA 8.2, no backlogs.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through the trade-off you made on the imbalance handling.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: SMOTE alone over-fit to synthetic minority — F1 looked great on train, dropped on holdout. Switched to focal loss with gamma 2.0 and a 3x undersampling on the majority, which made the recall improvement actually generalize. I logged the precision-recall curve per fold so the calibration was defensible to the team.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: How would you approach a SQL query to find the second-highest salary in an Employee table?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Window function — DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) in a CTE, then WHERE rnk = 2. Handles ties cleanly. If no window functions available, SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee) — but I'd flag the NULL case when there's only one distinct salary.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What's your CGPA and any backlogs to disclose?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 8.2, no active or history of backlogs.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Anything you want us to know about your preferences going in?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm open to any location — pan-India is fine, I'm comfortable relocating wherever TCS Digital places me. No constraints from my side.
